sections.text_helper: Section 8.10.8 "PWR wake-up configuration register (PWR_WUCR)" in chapter 8 (Power control (PWR)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 247.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x048
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Each WUPPUPDx (x=1 to 7), WUPPx (x=1 to 7), and WUPENx (x=1 to 7) is protected
against unprivileged access when PRIV=1 in PWR_PRIVCFGR.
Bits 31:30 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 29:16 WUPPUPDx[1:0]: Wake-up pin pull configuration for WKUPx (x=7to1)
These bits define the I/O pad pull configuration used when WUPENx = 1. The associated
GPIO port pull configuration must be set to the same value or to 00. The wake-up pin pull
configuration is kept in Standby mode.
00: No pull-up
01: Pull-up
10: Pull-down
11: Reserved
Bit 15 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 14:8 WUPPx: Wake-up pin polarity bit for WKUPx (x=7to1)
These bits define the polarity used for event detection on WUPx external wake-up pin.
0: Detection on high level (rising edge)
1: Detection on low level (falling edge)
Bit 7 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 6:0 WUPENx: Enable wake-up pin WKUPx (x=7to1)
These bits are set and cleared by software.
0: An event on WUPx pin does not wake-up the system from Standby mode.
1: A rising or falling edge on WUPx pin wakes up the system from Standby mode.
Note: An additional wake-up event is detected if WUPx pin is enabled (by setting the
WUPENx bit) when WUPx pin level is already high when WUPPx selects rising edge, or
low when WUPPx selects falling edge.
